mapper.sql: SELECT c.course_id, c.region_id, r.name AS region_name, c.name, c.description, c.status, c.sort_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_site cs WHERE cs.course_id = c.course_id) AS site_count FROM course c JOIN region r ON r.region_id = c.region_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (region_id, name, description, status, sort_no) VALUES (#{regionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sortNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET region_id = #{regionId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_no = #{sortNo} WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET status = #{status} WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilgrimage WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT course_id FROM course WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND name = #{name}
